scope: Bounded CPU checks of the release trainers and training-data commands in pytorch.sif. Small inputs cut from the archived pools; checks code paths, checkpoint compatibility and recorded settings, not training quality.

checks.main_from_scratch: one stage-2 epoch on 2000 events; validation loss 5.3594, equal to the earlier run 2286274
checks.main_resume_released_epoch19: resumed epoch 19, global_step 189767, no missing or unexpected keys; one more epoch, validation loss -0.0316
checks.tail_from_scratch_single_file: one epoch on 300 events (single-file mode, previously broken: no DataLoader built)
checks.tail_resume_TAIL10_epoch10: 421/421 tensors loaded, none re-initialised; one more epoch
checks.tail_shard_rotation: 6 shards x 300 events, 2 epochs: corrected loader printed 'train events:' 3 times, --historical_tail10_loader once, matching the TAIL10 log pattern
checks.mix_tail_shard: 300-event mixed shard from generation groups 0, then origin_reslice
checks.generate_benchmarks_training_recipe: 500 events with TRAIN_VAL_OPTS from unmixed_split, then origin_reslice

fixes_found: training.tail: the source trainer built no DataLoader in single-file mode and crashed on the first batch; fixed. TAIL10 used the shard template and never reached it.
training.main / training.tail: a training crash or missing input printed an error and exited 0; both now exit 1 so SLURM afterok chains stop.
environment_issue: Intermittent 'Illegal instruction' (SIGILL, exit 132) killed CPU training steps at the first batch on n4140, n4110 and n6110, on steps that passed on the same nodes in other runs. Not reproducible per node or step. The final run retried one step once on that signal and it then passed. GPU node g3200 was unavailable (stale gres allocation). Historical training ran on g3200.
not_performed: No full-length training run; no comparison of a retrained model's performance with the selected checkpoints.
